subject.title: fix(agents): retry same profile before timeout auth rotation

question: Should OpenClaw accept one same-model/profile retry for ordinary assistant timeouts before auth-profile rotation or model fallback?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but it deliberately changes compatibility-sensitive provider/profile fallback timing for existing setups, which requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout retry
options.body: Merge the PR with the one-retry policy because it preserves rate-limit/auth failover while avoiding profile rotation on the first ordinary timeout.

options.title: Preserve immediate fallback semantics
options.body: Ask for a revision that keeps first ordinary timeouts on the existing rotation/fallback path and handles transient timeout noise elsewhere.

options.title: Split session repair first
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the aborted-leaf transcript repair to land independently through #95766 before deciding the timeout policy.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout retry
recommendation.body: Merge the PR with the one-retry policy because it preserves rate-limit/auth failover while avoiding profile rotation on the first ordinary timeout.
